summary: SRPT 10-K is a textbook example of a clean-disclosure / impaired-business setup: three patient deaths from Elevidys/SRP-9004, a Nov 2025 boxed warning + non-ambulatory indication removal, the Nov 3 2025 ESSENCE confirmatory trial failure (PMO accelerated-approval at risk), EU rejection, AAVrh74 platform-designation revocation, and a securities class action are ALL named in the filing. Cross-checks (openFDA, clinicaltrials.gov, claim-evolution into Q1 2026, going-concern, auditor, USPTO) corroborate every key disclosure with no post-filing safety-narrative drift. The business is severely impaired but the framework finds essentially no disclosure-quality alpha to short — composite 0.125 (one MODERATE on the take-or-pay manufacturing overhang vs. shrunken Elevidys revenue) reflects honest disclosure of bad news.
